chemistry-killer-08.s.s1.prompt: Yawan maganin ruwa na sodium hydroxide ($\mathrm{NaOH}$, nauyin tsari 40) na 20 % (kashi cikin taro) shi ne 1.2 g/mL. Nawa ne mL na maganin NaOH na 20 % da ake buƙata idan za a ƙara masa ruwa don a samar da 600 mL na maganin ruwa na NaOH 0.5 M? (Nauyin atom H=1, O=16, Na=23. Molarity $M = \frac{10xd}{M_w}$, x shi ne kashi cikin taro, d shi ne yawan maganin g/mL.)
chemistry-killer-08.s.s1.explain:
Mataki na 1: Molarity na 20 % NaOH $M = \frac{10 \times 20 \times 1.2}{40} = 6.0$ mol/L (a 1 L = 1200 g na magani akwai NaOH 240 g = 6 mol).
Mataki na 2: Mole na solute a cikin maganin da za a shirya = 0.5 mol/L × 0.600 L = 0.30 mol (NaOH 12 g).
Mataki na 3: A ƙara ruwa mole na solute tsayayye ne: 6.0 × V = 0.30 → V = 0.050 L = 50 mL. (Dubawa: 12 g ÷ 0.20 = 60 g na magani, 60 g ÷ 1.2 g/mL = 50 mL)
Amsa: 50 mL (d). (Kuskure: 60 mL ƙima ce da aka lissafa ba tare da yawa ba tare da M = 5.0, 72 mL ƙima ce ta ninka 60 g da yawa, 5.0 mL kuskuren matsayin adadi ne)
chemistry-killer-08.s.s2.prompt: Which scenario demonstrates the correct real-world application of this principle?
chemistry-killer-08.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.
